features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: Scalable Printhead Configuration
items.desc: Supports 32, 48, 56, or 64 industrial-grade piezoelectric printheads, allowing manufacturers to precisely match machine capacity to current production volume and scale up as demand grows.

items.title: Exceptional Head Chilling System
items.desc: Dedicated printhead temperature control maintains stable operating conditions during sustained high-speed runs, preventing heat-related inconsistencies and protecting head performance.

items.title: Ink Misting Control Technology
items.desc: Advanced misting suppression reduces overspray and airborne ink particles, improving print clarity and edge definition even at peak production speeds.

items.title: High-Capacity Ink Supply System
items.desc: 30-litre per colour ink tanks support extended continuous production runs with minimal operator intervention and fewer refill interruptions during high-volume shifts.

items.title: Flexible Color Configuration
items.desc: Supports 4, 6, 7, and 8 color printing modes, giving manufacturers the flexibility to configure the machine for their specific design requirements and ink cost targets.

items.title: Versatile Drying System Options
items.desc: Choose from steam, electric, hot oil, or hybrid drying configurations to match your facility setup, fabric type, and production throughput requirements.

items.title: Adjustable Media Handling System
items.desc: Supports tension unwind, cloth trolley, and multiple outfeed configurations for smooth, wrinkle-free fabric transport across different fabric weights and roll formats.

items.title: Multiple Ink Type Compatibility
items.desc: Compatible with reactive, acid, pigment, disperse, and latex inks, making the K64 one of the most versatile ink platforms available in the high-speed industrial segment.

items.title: Real-Time Ink and Air Pressure Monitoring
items.desc: Continuous system monitoring across all ink and air circuits prevents mid-run failures and maintains stable print output under sustained high-speed operating conditions.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Ultra High-Volume Fashion Textile Production
fabrics.desc: Non-stop disperse printing on polyester fabrics for large wholesale and export operations where maximum daily output and fast turnaround are the primary business requirements.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Export Garment Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Reactive printing on cotton at industrial volume, meeting international wash fastness and quality standards across continuous multi-shift production schedules.

fabrics.title: Industrial Home Textile Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: High-capacity production of bedding, curtains, upholstery, and decorative textiles across cotton and polyester substrates for domestic and export markets at scale.

fabrics.title: Jacquard and Textured Fabric Printing
fabrics.desc: High-resolution output on complex woven and jacquard structures requiring precise registration and sharp pattern definition across very large production volumes.

fabrics.title: Silk and Luxury Textile Production
fabrics.desc: Acid ink printing on silk, viscose, and premium fabrics for manufacturers supplying luxury fashion brands and premium garment producers with tight quality requirements.

fabrics.title: Speciality and Technical Fabric Printing
fabrics.desc: Latex ink compatibility opens printing on coated, technical, and specialty substrates beyond standard textile applications, expanding business into new product categories.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Job Work and Multi-Buyer Operations
fabrics.desc: Wide fabric compatibility from 30 to 450 gsm and multi-ink support make the K64 the preferred choice for high-capacity job work units serving large, diverse client portfolios.

productionCapacity.description: Choose the ideal speed and resolution combination to optimize production output and print performance.
